description: This PHP file defines the PerformanceTrackerAPI class within the OrangeHRM Performance module. It implements RESTful endpoints for managing performance trackers, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting trackers. The class utilizes traits for authentication and date/time handling, and interacts with the PerformanceTracker service and DAO for data operations. It also includes detailed OpenAPI annotations for API documentation.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerAPI
classes.description: API class providing endpoints for managing Performance Tracker entities, including CRUD operations and listing with optional filtering and pagination. Implements RESTful API with OpenAPI annotations for documentation.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list all performance trackers with filtering, sorting, and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new performance tracker.

methods.name: setPerformanceTrackerParams
methods.description: Sets common performance tracker data from request parameters, including name, employee number, and reviewer emp numbers.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the getAll method, including access control and pagination.

methods.name: getCommonBodyParamRulesCollection
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the request body parameters for create and update operations.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove performance trackers by IDs.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the delete method.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves a specific performance tracker by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for fetching one tracker.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing performance tracker identified by ID.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the update operation.
